description: lib.rs: ClosureHandler stores call_fn: Box<dyn Fn(Arc<B>, String, serde_json::Value) -> HandlerFuture>. The String call_id is passed by value even though handler code immediately passes &ci to downstream functions (handle_email_copy, handle_submission_set). This forces an allocation-and-copy at every dispatch invocation even for handlers that bind _ci. The JmapHandler::call signature (jmap-server crate) likely takes call_id: String by value already, but the closure could take &str instead if the trait allows it, or the ClosureHandler could forward &call_id and the closure parameter could be &str. Compare with jmap-chat-server/src/backend.rs to check whether it avoids this. The practical cost per call is one String allocation that could be avoided, but more importantly it establishes an inconsistent ownership pattern: handlers that need call_id pay the same cost as handlers that don't.
title: ClosureHandler call_fn takes String call_id by value — forces allocation at every dispatch
